note: GTA Regional Purchasing Parity index. Computed as: (regional basket cost) / (regional top hourly yield). A GTA-RPP ratio > 1.0 means the region is more expensive relative to what players earn there. Analogous to the Eurozone RPP divergence metric. Requires vice-city-prices.json and leonida-prices.json to be populated post-launch.

franchise_reference.note: GTA-PPI is the single-market predecessor. GTA-RPP extends this to multi-region divergence measurement.
